name: Seedance
description: Seedance is ByteDance's text-to-video model, primarily accessed through Volcengine API or ByteDance's consumer apps Jimeng and Dreamina. Seedance 2.0 (February 2026) added stronger character consistency and multi-second extensions. Frequently reaches the top of leaderboards alongside Sora and Veo.
pricingDetails: API: ~$0.092/sec (480p) to $0.199/sec (720p) via Volcengine. Jimeng/Dreamina consumer plans from ~$9.60/month.
